message.content: The incident has been escalated to the DPO for a human decision because the severity score of 4.0 falls within 0.25 of a band threshold [F02][F05][F03]. The provisional action is to notify the supervisory authority and affected individuals [F02][F05][F03]. The breach involves bank account, name, PESEL, and salary data for up to 310 data subjects [F02][F04]. Unauthorised access was reported by the processor, and the data was not rendered unintelligible due to provider-managed encryption [F03][F05].
